source_review.notes: Checked all 12 structured references against current official W3C, NIST, OpenTelemetry, OpenLineage, RFC Editor, AWS, OWASP, CISA, and SLSA sources; every final URL returned HTTP 200. Verified PROV entity/activity/agent and responsibility relations, current log Timestamp/ObservedTimestamp and trace fields, current OpenLineage job/run/dataset/version semantics, NIST audit/log-management scope, RFC time-stamp and transparency-log mechanisms, CloudTrail integrity validation, logging security/minimization guidance, and provenance framing in their stated domains. The chapter treats RFC 9162 and SLSA as transferable mechanism/context examples, not universal audit-log standards.

evidence: Checked the evidence-event tuple, provenance graph sets and labeled relations, required/observed/missing/excluded populations, hash-chain recurrence, protected anchor, timestamps, uncertainty intervals and causal partial-order notation.
Checked union, set difference, disjoint union, cardinality, concatenation, intervals, implication and approximately-equal syntax for defined symbols and balanced GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation consistently separates versioned things and responsibilities, eligible-population coverage, byte-integrity commitments, protected checkpoints and uncertain distributed time.

evidence: Executed audit-event-hash-chain and matched three events, a valid original chain, an invalid tampered chain and the explicit false truth-proof claim exactly.
Recomputed Exercise 3: 49,850 observed + 120 missing + 30 excluded = 50,000 eligible; required denominator 49,970; 49,850 / 49,970 = 0.9975985591, which rounds to 99.76%.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Duplicates do not increase unique-ID coverage, the 10 invalid records remain a reason subset of the 120 missing mappings, and late events are accounted according to the stated final watermark.

evidence: Expanded h_i = H(domain || schema_i || h_(i-1) || C(e_i)) and confirmed covered record modification, reordering or interior deletion changes the recomputed anchored prefix under deterministic canonicalization and collision resistance.
Verified Q_W = O_W disjoint-union M_W disjoint-union X_W supports complete observed coverage only when Q_W is independently exact, exclusions are governed/disjoint and mappings are one-to-one.
Verified overlapping clock-uncertainty intervals do not justify wall-clock order, while an explicit causal relation supplies a scoped partial order.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The derivations preserve the distinction between integrity of committed bytes, complete observed coverage for a defined population, event truth, semantic correctness and human intent.

invariant_checking.notes: No hash, signature, chain, Merkle proof, timestamp, immutable store, collector result, dashboard, lineage edge, credential or custody record is described as proving more than its stated assumptions support.

evidence: Reviewed the conditional integrity argument from predecessor binding and an authentic protected terminal checkpoint for modification, reorder and interior-deletion detection.
Reviewed the conditional completeness argument from an exact independent eligible population, governed exclusions, disjoint reconciliation and one-to-one valid mappings.

Confirmed collision resistance, deterministic canonicalization, trustworthy key/process/time, complete supplied range, denominator independence and retrievability are explicit assumptions or failure boundaries.
proof_review.notes: The proof sketches support scoped evidence properties and explicitly exclude truthful capture, semantic correctness, global event completeness and human intent.

evidence: Integrity and completeness statements are explicitly labeled conditional claims and their arguments explicitly labeled proof sketches.
The immediately adjacent text names assumption failures, denominator blind spots, invalid evidence and omitted-event limits.
The executable is explicitly labeled a constrained illustration and disclaims event truth, completeness and production-grade canonicalization.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Formal relation, proof sketch, executable observation, platform behavior, operational evidence and assurance/legal conclusions remain visibly separate.

evidence: Current OpenTelemetry, OpenLineage, AWS, NIST, OWASP, CISA and SLSA behavior/guidance is attributed to named official sources rather than generalized to every implementation.

Events, source journals, acknowledgments, gaps, digests, signatures, checkpoints, timestamps, custody records and retrieval drills are described as evidence inputs whose conclusions require interpretation.
External audit, legal/privacy/records obligations, approved exclusions and control conclusions are assigned to qualified roles and stated scopes rather than inferred from technical artifacts.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: The chapter consistently marks logged assertion, observed execution, mathematical property, current documented behavior, internal review and external assurance as different evidence classes.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the chapter end to end.
